offering_description.value: The company supplies electricity, broadband internet, and telephone service to homes, businesses, and public facilities in rural Alaska. It generates and distributes power through local utility systems and delivers internet and phone service over its telecommunications networks.

primary_services.value: electric power distribution; broadband internet access; local telephone service

customer_segment.value: B2C: households in rural Alaska; B2B: local businesses and private institutions; B2G: local government offices and public schools

end_markets.value: residential utilities; commercial utilities; residential and business telecommunications; public facilities

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: metered electricity consumption; subscription: monthly broadband and telephone plans

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: runs hydroelectric and diesel plants, local electric grids, and communications networks serving rural communities; service provider: uses local networks to deliver electricity, broadband, and phone service to homes, businesses, and public facilities

geography_served.value: US regional: rural communities in Southeast and Interior Alaska

specialization.value: related lines: electric power, broadband, and telephone services for rural Alaska communities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: customers establish service directly with the utility or telecommunications provider

regulatory_exposure.value: high: electric utility and telecommunications oversight by the Regulatory Commission of Alaska and federal communications regulation by the FCC

notes: The current relative scale of the electric and telecommunications operations is uncertain.
